title: Xavier and He Initialization
signature: def init_weights(fan_in: int, fan_out: int, u: np.ndarray, z: np.ndarray) -> dict
hints: A uniform distribution on [-a, a] has variance a^2 / 3.
Xavier wants variance 2 / (fan_in + fan_out), so a = sqrt(6 / (fan_in + fan_out)).
Map u in [0, 1) to [-a, a) with (2u - 1) * a. He normal is just z * sqrt(2 / fan_in).
